explication: Adobe Skills is a repository of installable skills and plugins for AI coding agents, spanning analytics, AEM, commerce, Workfront, web tooling, and site delivery. The user-facing flow is to install a plugin through a supported agent ecosystem, then invoke a skill for domain-specific guidance or work; documented analytics skills may use Adobe MCP servers, while Workfront guidance searches public documentation. The tree shows many additional specialist skills, but their internal orchestration is not established by the supplied excerpts, so the graph stays at plugin boundaries.
